name: sh.valv/mcp
title: valv
description: Let coding agents query SQL databases, ClickHouse, and MongoDB safely. Read-only by default and scoped by your policies.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Database connection string. PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, CockroachDB, MongoDB, or a ClickHouse HTTP URL.

environmentVariables.name: VALV_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Datasource provider: postgresql, mysql, sqlite, mongodb, or clickhouse. Inferred from DATABASE_URL when omitted.

environmentVariables.name: VALV_DATABASE
environmentVariables.description: Database name for ClickHouse or MongoDB. MongoDB can also take it from the connection URL.

environmentVariables.name: VALV_TABLES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allow-list of tables. When set, only these are exposed to the agent.

environmentVariables.name: VALV_EXCLUDE
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated deny-list of tables, applied after the allow-list.

environmentVariables.name: VALV_POLICY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a policy module that takes full control of access. Without it, the server is read-only across all tables.

environmentVariables.name: VALV_CONTEXT
environmentVariables.description: JSON context object the policy reads, e.g. {"tenant":{"id":"acme"}}.

environmentVariables.name: VALV_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Serve over Streamable HTTP on this port instead of stdio.
